rules: Mission templates shape task structure but never create the factual incident they respond to.
Every generated mission traces to live World State, standing duty or valid command policy.
NPC units may resolve needs without the player.
Player proximity is not sufficient reason for assignment.
Capability, readiness, legal access, chain of command and existing orders constrain selection.
Quiet periods are valid when no justified player tasking exists.
Mission completion produces consequences in World State rather than generic XP rewards.
AI may brief and dramatize only already-authorized mission/world facts.
